content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Cloud HR, payroll and benefits software plus outsourced HR and payroll processing for employers, overlapping Paylocity's HCM and payroll model."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Cloud HCM software with payroll processing and tax filing for small and mid-sized employers, closely matching Paylocity's model."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Payroll, HR and benefits software plus payroll and tax filing services for employers, the core of Paylocity's business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Cloud fax, document delivery and email marketing software; no payroll or HR business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer engagement and knowledge software for contact centers; different product and buyer."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Health savings account custody and administration; a benefits-account business rather than payroll or HR software."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mainly tax preparation, accounting and consumer finance; payroll is a secondary line, not the core business."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Cloud HCM software with payroll, tax filing and talent management sold directly to US employers, mirroring Paylocity."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Application development, data integration and infrastructure software for IT teams; unrelated to payroll or HR."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone, video and contact center communications software; no payroll or HR function."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise social media and customer experience platform for brands; different product and customers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Financial institution software and fund administration for asset managers and banks; different customers and operations."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise work management, content and records software; no payroll or HR products."}]}
